record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare SHORE_UP in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, max HP, and (per cast) the weather.
record.summary: The caster heals itself by a fraction of its own current max HP (0.2 at 1 star, 0.25 at 2 stars, 0.4 at 3 stars, 0.8 at 4 stars and as fallback), plus 0.1 added to the fraction when the simulation weather is SANDSTORM (so 0.3 / 0.35 for the listed 1- and 2-star units), through handleHeal with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag. Because requiresTarget is false it can be cast without a target in range. Requested amount = healFactor x maxHP; the applied amount then follows the heal helper (PokemonState.handleHeal): a wounded caster gets 0 healing (under BLOODMOON weather with the player's BLOOD_STONE items a shield of round(0.3 x stones x requested heal) is requested instead via addShield); a caster at hp 0 or with status.protect gets 0 (Rune Protect alone does not block it); otherwise x(1 + AP/100), x critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false), x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP. Overheal on a caster with the GRASS synergy effect adds max HP via addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). The strategy ignores the returned values. No damage, status, movement or shield of its own.

targeting.note: requiresTarget = false, the cast target is not used.

declaredRaw.label: requested heal = fraction of the caster's current max HP (healFactor, before AP/crit); +0.1 to the fraction in SANDSTORM

perUnitRaw.SANDYGAST: 0.2 x max HP (0.3 x max HP in SANDSTORM)
perUnitRaw.PALOSSAND: 0.25 x max HP (0.35 x max HP in SANDSTORM)

effects.scaling: requested = (table[stars-1] ?? 0.8, + 0.1 if simulation.weather === SANDSTORM) x pokemon.maxHP; then AP: x(1 + AP/100) because apBoost is 1; then x critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (canCritByDefault false, so this needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied: 0 if the caster is wounded (status.wound; with BLOODMOON weather and BLOOD_STONE items a shield of round(0.3 x stones x requested heal) is requested instead, see core-mechanics §J), or at 0 hp, or status.protect (Rune Protect alone blocks neither); otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP (maxHP - hp). The uncapped excess (overheal) adds addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) if the caster has the GRASS synergy effect (not 40 % of max HP). Requested, applied (healReceived) and overheal are separate amounts; the strategy ignores the returned values.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (0.4) and 4-star/fallback (0.8) values are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. maxPP 90, range 1 and max HP are in appliesTo / the unit blocks.

record.positionalConditions: None: the strategy reads no coordinates. One state condition: pokemon.simulation.weather === SANDSTORM adds 0.1 to the heal fraction.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and heals once; the weather is re-read on every cast. Healing is capped at missing HP, so a cast at full HP produces only overheal.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 0.2 (1 star) or 0.25 (2 stars) of the caster's current max HP, +0.1 of max HP in SANDSTORM, then x(1 + AP/100) [x critPower if the cast crit]. Applied: after the heal helper's wound / protect gate, modifiers (BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, burn, enraged, ZENITH), rounding and the cap at missing HP; the applied amount can be 0 and never exceeds missing HP. The remainder is overheal (GRASS: addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal)).
